messages:
Alex Nguyen: Quick sync — proposal for handling default model unpinning and graceful fallback.
Alex Nguyen: TL;DR: add an `X-Accept-Model` negotiation header + server-side fallback to a quantized-compatible variant, deprecate the old default in 6 weeks, and run a staged canary (5 -> 25 -> 100).
Maria Chen: +1 on header negotiation. Do we require SDK changes or can server shim if header missing?
Alex Nguyen: Server shim is possible, but we should add SDK helpers to set header and surface warnings. Plan: start with server fallback for existing SDKs, release SDK lint that warns about missing header in next minor.
Sam Ortiz: How will telemetry look? need to distinguish client-supplied pins vs server fallback for billing/alerts.
Alex Nguyen: Good call. We'll emit `x-fallback-reason` metric tag: values `no-header`, `incompatible-pin`, `capacity-fallback`. Also log `chosen_model` in structured logs.
Priya Kapoor: Docs/console change request: expose a per-route deprecation banner and a rollback button for canary. Chunking the rollout in console UI should map to our 5/25/100 phases.
Grace (PM): Timeline check — 6 weeks deprecation feels tight for some enterprise customers. What about 8 weeks with an opt-in accelerated path?
Alex Nguyen: Suggest 6 weeks default, but enterprise customers get a manual 8- or 12-week SLA. We can offer dedicated dedicated pinned capacity as alternative.
Maria Chen: Example curl snippet for negotiation? Post it and I'll add to SDK README.
Alex Nguyen: Sure:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
     -H "X-Accept-Model: gpt-redwood-v1, gpt-redwood-v1-quantized;q=0.7" \
     -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Sam Ortiz: For rollback safety, add a circuit-breaker that auto-rolls back to pinned variant if latency > 2s for 3 consecutive 1-min windows.
Priya Kapoor: Canary plan: week 1 = 5% for 48h, week 2 = 25% for 72h, then 100% after QA and thumbs up. Also run a prompt set eval on each stage.
DeployBot: deploy pipeline triggered: branch `model-accept-header` -> staging.
Maria Chen: Code review ping: @alex-ng branch has the server-side shim + metric tagging. @sam-ops can you review the circuit-breaker hooks?
Sam Ortiz: I'll review tonight. Quick note: ensure we tag traces with `model_selection=auto/fallback/pin` for SRE dashboards.
Grace (PM): I'll draft a comms blurb for customers: deprecation windows, suggested migration steps, and contact for exceptions.
Alex Nguyen: Action items: (1) Alex: land shim + metric tags; (2) Maria: SDK warning + README snippet; (3) Sam: circuit-breaker + tracing; (4) Priya: console canary UI; (5) Grace: external comms. Target: canary start in 2 weeks.
Priya Kapoor: Adding: create a small internal test harness to run the regression prompts on each stage and post pass/fail to the rollout ticket.
Alex Nguyen: Thanks everyone. If no blockers, I’ll cut the staging PR today. :thumbsup:
note: Single-thread Slack export: messages field is a continuous string; no title included per agents.md. Keeps timestamps as root/first/last.
